item.text: I’ve already cleaned up the core simulation loop once. I’m looking for the next highest-value refactor now, likely around duplicated reader/setup code or object creation paths, and I’ll keep it behavior-preserving.
The next seam is the CSV-loading layer. It has repeated parsing/reset logic and a couple of awkward loops, so I’m tightening that up without changing the public API.

I found one design issue worth fixing while I’m in here: `ClimateScenarios` is mutable enum state, so repeated simulations can leak temperature changes across runs. I’m folding that into the refactor alongside the CSV cleanup because both are setup-layer concerns.
The loader and scenario setup refactor is in. I’m compiling now and checking for any dead code or fallout from the cleanup.

item.text:
I continued the refactor in the setup/loading layer.

`CSVReader` now has a single path for reading CSV rows, so lookup and choice-list generation no longer duplicate file-walking logic in [CSVReader.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/CSVReader.java:11). The concrete readers were simplified to use explicit column-count constants and direct parsing in [AnimalCSVReader.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/AnimalCSVReader.java:10), [PlantCSVReader.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/PlantCSVReader.java:10), and [HabitatCSVReader.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/HabitatCSVReader.java:11). In particular, the habitat reader no longer mixes season parsing and plant concentration assignment inside one index loop.

I also cleaned up scenario setup in [Initializer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/Initializer.java:168) and fixed the mutable-enum leak by adding a reset hook in [ClimateScenarios.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R005_module_java/ClimateScenarios.java:8). That keeps repeated simulations from inheriting prior climate-change state.

Verification: `javac *.java` still passes. The only remaining compiler note is the pre-existing unchecked warning in `MenuView.java`.
